extras: The plugin operates entirely locally; no data is sent to external services. The author is collecting retrieval feedback on its performance.
motivation: The author is collecting retrieval feedback to determine if the plugin surfaces the notes users would manually provide to an AI assistant.
problem: AI assistants often waste context by reading too many notes, leading to inefficient retrieval when analyzing large vaults.
summary: Context Prism is a token-aware context routing tool that prepares compact, locally generated Markdown context packs for AI assistants based on note relevance.
